decisionsTitle: «Spune-ne ceva» chooses with cards and icons, every form opens with «Anonim» / «Cu nume și prenume», and the safety form says it is for women (amending §676)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-09, looking at QA's `/ro/contact/spune-ne` on a phone:** «Vreau niște chestii mai frumos vizuale și iconițe. Siguranță devine "Siguranță pentru Femei" cu subtitlul, știm că în alergarea ca femeie aduce niște extra provocări... Sau combină Sugestii și Reclamații I guess. Sau zi "Girl Zone" să nu pară așa că mama ce fatalai sunt Brașov Runners».

Step 1 of the wizard (§676) was four plain radios with a grey hint under each — correct, and the plainest thing on the site. The safety branch read «Siguranță» / «Pentru femeile care nu s-au simțit în siguranță la noi. Confidențial.», which reads as if something had already gone wrong.

**Decision.**

- **Cards.** Each branch offered is a card: its glyph on a 40-pixel rounded tile, the branch's name in bold, its hint under it. One column on a phone, two from 600 pixels, the phone's gap `DENSITY.gapSm`. A chosen card is outlined two pixels wide in the primary colour on a light primary tint, whichever branch it is; only the glyph's tile carries a tint of its branch's own — the primary colour for the three ordinary forms, the secondary for the women's, so it reads as a place of its own rather than a fourth complaint. Every card is at least 44 pixels tall and the whole card is the tap target.
- **Still a native form.** Each card is a `<label>` around the real `<input type="radio" name="tip">`, left visible at the card's right edge and painted in the primary colour (`accent-color`), so the keyboard, a screen reader and a page with no JavaScript behave exactly as with the plain radios before; the card's outline and tint follow `:checked` through CSS `:has()` alone. A keyboard's focus rings the whole card — two pixels in the primary colour's own variable, two pixels out (`:has(input:focus-visible)`), so it follows the colour scheme. The radio is named by the branch's title alone and described by its hint (`aria-labelledby`, `aria-describedby`), so a screen reader says «Siguranță pentru femei» first and the sentence after it, not one long name. «Continuă» is the same `GET`, `?tip=` the same step, the first branch (or the one `?tip=` named) checked by default. No client island, no dependency. The fieldset is `src/modules/feedback/ui/BranchChoice.tsx`, a Server Component.
- **One glyph per branch, `FEEDBACK_BRANCH_GLYPH`** (`src/modules/feedback/ui/branch-glyph.ts`), drawn on step 1's card and again beside the branch's title on step 2, so the picture a visitor chose is the one above the form she fills: «Cum a fost» a runner (`DirectionsRun`), «O sugestie» a light bulb (`LightbulbOutlined`), «O reclamație» the triangle that says something is wrong (`ReportProblemOutlined`), «Siguranță pentru femei» a heart outline (`FavoriteBorder`). The heart over the shield, of the two the brief allowed: a shield says defence and danger, the very tone the owner asked to lose; a heart says the club cares, and it is not the hand holding a heart the event pages already use for a donation (`VolunteerActivism`, `events/ui/glyphs.ts`). The glyphs are decoration (`aria-hidden`); the words carry the meaning.
- **«Siguranță pentru femei».** The name says whom it is for; the hint says why without fear: «Știm că alergatul, ca femeie, vine cu provocări în plus. Dacă ceva te-a făcut să nu te simți în siguranță la noi, spune-ne — confidențial.» / "We know running as a woman comes with extra challenges. If something made you feel unsafe with us, tell us — confidentially." The form's heading takes the same name, the backoffice switch reads «Siguranță pentru femei (confidențial)», and the door's sentence on `/contact`, when this form is the only one offered (`doorIntroKey`), becomes «Un formular confidențial pentru femeile care nu s-au simțit în siguranță la noi.» / "A confidential form for women who did not feel safe with us." — amending BR-REQ-070-04 criterion 30.
- **The name everywhere.** The backoffice's line on the roads (`Admin.emails.feedbackForms.roads`), the safety email's footer («Trimis prin formularul confidențial „Siguranță pentru femei” al site-ului») and the privacy notice's template (section 5, three times) say «Siguranță pentru femei» / “Safety for women” too. The template moves anyway for the choice below, so the club approves the notice once for both.
- **What does not move.** The email's subject stays `SAFETY_SUBJECT`, «Mesaj confidențial de pe site»: it names nobody and nothing, on purpose (§676), whichever mode the person chose.

**Refused.**

- **Merging «O sugestie» and «O reclamație».** Each has its own switch, its own recipient and its own email subject (§676); merging them is a settings and email change, not a visual one, and the owner offered it as an alternative («sau»). Kept apart.
- **«Girl Zone».** An English name on a Romanian page, and a playful one for the one form whose reader is a single designated person; «Siguranță pentru femei» with a warm subtitle answers the same worry.

**The owner, 2026-10-09, again:** «In wizzard partea de \"Anonim/Cu nume și prenume\" ar trebui să fie chiar sus, un radio».

**Decision.** Every branch's form (step 2) opens with that choice:

- **A fieldset at the very top**, before every other box, the radio named `identity`: «Anonim» (`anonymous`, checked by default) / «Cu nume și prenume» (`named`), under the legend «Cum trimiți mesajul?» / "How do you send it?". In English "Anonymous" / "With my first and last name".
- **The named mode's boxes, and only there.** «Numele și prenumele» and the branch's existing way back — the address on the three ordinary forms, the address or telephone on «Siguranță pentru femei» — sit under the choice, moved up from the end of the form, and show only while «Cu nume și prenume» is checked: CSS `:has()` on the wrapper (`display: none` when «Anonim» is checked), no client island. A browser without `:has()` simply shows them; nothing depends on hiding them. The name carries no `required` attribute and the address box is `inputMode="email"` rather than `type="email"`, because the browser would refuse a post on a box it hid; the server is the check.
- **The server drops them when anonymous.** Anything posted as `identity` but `named` reads as anonymous, and then the name, the address and the contact are blanked before the fields are read (`feedbackFields`' preprocessing in `feedback/domain/branches.ts`) — a box the page hid is never refused and never sent, so a half-typed address the person then chose not to give does not stop the message. In the named mode a name is required, refused on its own box («Numele») beside any other refusal; the way back stays optional.
- **The email's first line is «Nume: …»** — the name given, or «(anonim)» (`ANONYMOUS_NAME_LINE`) — so the reader knows at a glance, as «(fără contact lăsat)» already says for the way back. On the three ordinary branches the `Reply-To` carries the name with the address.
- **The draft keeps both.** A refused post comes back with the choice and the name in the sealed draft (§142), the named boxes visible again; never in the address.
- **The notice.** The privacy notice's template, section 5, now says the forms are anonymous unless the person chooses to give a name, with an address or telephone if they want an answer, and that in the anonymous mode neither is sent even when typed. The texts in force keep their words until the club approves the notice from the template; the page does not wait for it — the notice in force already names the way back, and the name is the person's own choice, written on the form.

**Refused.** A third mode (a contact without a name): the owner's two words are the two modes, and a way back is already optional inside the named one.
changelogLine: - **«Spune-ne ceva» chooses with cards and icons, and every form opens with «Anonim» / «Cu nume și prenume»** — each kind of message is a card with its own picture, kept beside the form's title; the name and the way back show only when the person chooses to give them, and the email's first line says the name or «(anonim)». Still plain forms working without JavaScript. The safety form is now «Siguranță pentru femei», with a warmer subtitle. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Given two or more branches offered, when step 1 of `/<locale>/contact/spune-ne` renders, then each branch is a card — a `<label>` around a visible native radio named `tip` whose value is the branch's slug, the branch's glyph from `FEEDBACK_BRANCH_GLYPH` on a 40-pixel tile, its name and its hint — at least 44 pixels tall, with no sideways scroll at 320 pixels; the first branch (or the one in `?tip=`) is checked, a press anywhere on a card chooses it, a chosen card is outlined in the primary colour, a card whose radio has the keyboard's focus carries a two-pixel ring in the primary colour, each radio is named by the branch's title alone and described by its hint, and «Continuă» is the same `GET` with `?tip=<slug>`, working without JavaScript (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a branch's form on step 2, then its title carries the same glyph tile as its card on step 1; «Cum a fost» is a runner, «O sugestie» a light bulb, «O reclamație» a warning triangle and «Siguranță pentru femei» a heart outline, every glyph `aria-hidden` (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The safety branch is named «Siguranță pentru femei» / "Safety for women", with the hint «Știm că alergatul, ca femeie, vine cu provocări în plus. Dacă ceva te-a făcut să nu te simți în siguranță la noi, spune-ne — confidențial.» / "We know running as a woman comes with extra challenges. If something made you feel unsafe with us, tell us — confidentially."; its email's subject stays «Mesaj confidențial de pe site», and its footer names the form «Siguranță pentru femei» (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Amending criterion 30's door sentence: with «Siguranță pentru femei» the only branch offered, the door's sentence on `/contact` names that form alone — «Un formular confidențial pentru femeile care nu s-au simțit în siguranță la noi.» / "A confidential form for women who did not feel safe with us." — never the three that are not there (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given any branch's form on step 2, then its first box is a fieldset with the radio `identity` — «Anonim» checked by default, and «Cu nume și prenume» — and «Numele și prenumele» with the branch's way back (the address, or for «Siguranță pentru femei» the address or telephone) show under it only while «Cu nume și prenume» is checked, in CSS alone, with no sideways scroll at 320 pixels (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a post whose `identity` is anything but `named`, then the name, the address and the contact are dropped before validation — never refused, never sent, no `Reply-To`; given `named` with an empty name, the post is refused naming the box `name`; the email's first line is «Nume: <the name>» or «Nume: (anonim)», and its subject is unchanged (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given a refused post in the named mode, when the form comes back, then «Cu nume și prenume» is checked and the name and the way back are refilled from the sealed draft, never from the address (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

The privacy notice's template, section 5, says the {{feedbackForms}} forms are anonymous unless the person chooses to give a name (with an address or telephone for an answer), that neither is sent in the anonymous mode, and names the confidential form «Siguranță pentru femei» / “Safety for women” (2026-10-09, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the feedback choice is cards with icons, and every form opens with anonymous or named
